name: Vacqueyras

limits: For red wine, Grenache: at least 50%
For red wine, Mourvèdre and Syrah together: at least 20%

For rosé wine, Bourboulenc, Brun Argenté, Carignan, Clairette, Clairette Rose, Counoise, Grenache Blanc, Grenache Gris, Marsanne, Muscardin, Piquepoul Noir, Roussanne, Terret Noir and Viognier together: at most 10%
For red wine, Grenache, Mourvèdre and Syrah together: at least 90%

terms: France's protected place names. A wine sold under one must follow that appellation's rules. The EU's term for the same tier is PDO, or AOP in French.
There is no legal or agreed definition of old, so the words promise nothing on their own.

notes: Vacqueyras reds are mainly Grenache, with Syrah and Mourvèdre, and are powerful, rich and full bodied.

blurb.text: A southern Rhône cru, at the foot of the Dentelles de Montmirail. It is mostly red, led by Grenache with Syrah and Mourvèdre, with some white and rosé.
